notes.title: Greenjamin skates into a brand-new sequel, SKATOR GATOR 3D!
notes.content:
[h3]Weathered Sweater is proud to announce Greenjamin Gator's return in [b]SKATOR GATOR 3D[/b], the brand-new sequel to Skator Gator![/h3]

After taking the fight to the robo-capitalists in Rat City, our skating gator has new challenges to tackle across unique 3D locales — from sunset-bathed swamps to moonlit marshes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XHk0L5v.png[/img]

The lane-based platforming of the original game returns with familiar powerups influencing your gameplay in new ways, and the 3D platforming areas will have you exploring every nook and cranny for all sorts of collectables.

[h3]This adventure in the third dimension is one you don't want to miss![/h3]
[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1996470/Skator_Gator_3D/][b]Wishlist the game now on Steam![/b][/url][/h3]

notes.title: Skator Gator is Out Now!
notes.content:
The Year of the Gator starts today as our plucky hero prepares to venture across miles of pipe to fight for his ravaged home. [b]Are you ready to grind with Greenjamin?[/b] 🛹🐊

Take advantage of our 10% launch week discount and pick up Skator Gator for yourself, your friends, or your local alligator congregation — it’s available on both PC and Mac!

notes.title: Skator Gator Arrives on January 17th!
notes.content:
Greenjamin’s 2022 Resolutions:
🔳 [i]Grind pipes[/i]
🔳 [i]Smash capitalism[/i]
🔳 [i]Save the environment[/i]
🔳 [i]Launch on Steam January 17th[/i]

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Welcome to a brand new year!

Despite the news out there about it being the year of the tiger (woo, stripes), we're celebrating 2022 as the year of the [b]GATOR[/b]! Why?

[b]Skator Gator[/b] arrives on Steam for PC/Mac on [b]Monday, January 17th[/b], that's why!

We can't wait to have you grind and skate through 20+ levels of tricky lane platforming filled with eggs, enemies, and all sorts of obstacles to dodge ━ tell your friends to join the call by wishlisting us right here on Steam.

[b]Help Greenjamin Gator grind pipes, smash capitalism, and save the environment![/b]
